svg.title: Power BI Embedded SaaS Starter
svg.desc: Conceptual overview with the signed-in user above the highlighted application, identity and credentials to the left, tenant analytics to the right, and supporting identities and application data below.

g.text: A secure portal for tenant analytics.
Conceptual overview | Double arrows show requests and responses, not which service initiates every call.
One tenant per user. One workspace and embedding principal per tenant. Shared compute never merges permissions.
Service groups are conceptual, not Azure resource-group boundaries. See the deployment view for physical placement.
